race.title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A tricky betting race with a few likely to have one eye on the Pertemps Final itself. ROAD TO WEMBLEY has enjoyed a fine year over hurdles and may be rewarded with a fourth victory. Ernest Gray could make a bold bid to defy a career-high mark, with East India Express very much respected given his record around here. ROAD TO WEMBLEY ERNEST GRAY (IRE) EAST INDIA EXPRESS (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Ernest Gray (9/4), East India Express (11/4), Idaho Fire (5/1), Ikarak (11/2), Road To Wembley (11/2), Marsiac (12/1)
